exposure: sutured intrauterine device (IUD) insertion during trans-cesarean section
non-sutured intrauterine device (IUD) insertion during trans-cesarean section
cohort: The study included 88 patients who underwent trans-cesarean intrauterine device (IUD) insertion, divided into two groups: 44 with sutured IUD and 44 with non-sutured IUD.
finding: There were no statistically significant differences in IUD expulsion rates between sutured and non-sutured models of trans-cesarean IUD insertion, although the non-sutured group had a numerically higher expulsion rate (11.4%).
